<?php
function peerShift241() { $GLOBALS['late'] = 99; $GLOBALS['owner'] = null; $GLOBALS['runner'] = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerBase241 {
    public $tag;
    public $text;
    public function __construct($tag) { $this->tag = $tag; echo 'CTOR:', self::class, ':', static::class, ':', $tag, ';'; return 9; }
    public function capture($saved, $ignored) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'INSTANCE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $this; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'END:', $this->tag, ';'; }
}
class PeerScope241 extends PeerBase241 {
    public function run() { global $owner, $late; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: (([new parent(3), 'capture'])(...))($late, peerShift241())); }
}
class PeerChild241 extends PeerScope241 { public function capture($saved, $ignored) { echo 'WRONG;'; return false; } }
class PeerMagic241 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { $GLOBALS['kept'] = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$owner = new PeerMagic241; $runner = new PeerChild241(8);
$result = $runner->run(); echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept->text, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
